events.content:
Enabled Cache Components and Partial Prefetching in [next.config.ts](/workspace/next.config.ts). Product lookups now use `use cache` with slug and currency as arguments, so details can be reused across requests while EUR and USD prices stay distinct.

The [product page](/workspace/app/products/[slug]/page.tsx) now sends a useful shop shell and loading message first. Product details follow, then related products stream through a separate Suspense boundary. Related product links preserve the selected currency. No route opt-outs were added.

**Verification:** `npm run build` passed. The built server returned the expected EUR and USD prices, and related items arrived after the product details. Unknown slugs display the not-found UI; because the shell has already started streaming, their HTTP response status is 200.
